scope: Extend the approved tactile editor approach across the shared admin's operational pages, navigation, forms, dialogs, lists and other document editors.

mobileRefinements.request: Phone screenshots: compact the clients layout, remove scrolling inside quote/contract tab strips, and animate mobile sheets with a drag-to-close handle while preserving existing dismissal.
mobileRefinements.clients: Compact wrapping stats; paired category/status filters; full-width search; gutter-aligned tag action; title and add action share a row when space permits.
mobileRefinements.tabs: Remove the auto-overflow container and negative bottom margin that produced a 43px scrollport around 44px controls. Tabs wrap if necessary; page and data-table scrolling are unchanged.

sheets.motion: 240ms slide/fade on open and close; 160ms snap-back; reduced-motion preference skips animations.
sheets.drag: Handle-only downward drag with pointer capture; short/cancelled drags return to rest; a completed drag continues into the closing animation.
sheets.content: Only the content region scrolls. Handle and header remain available without covering focused fields.
sheets.dismissal: Close button, outside tap, Escape and parent-driven cancellation retained. Existing modal lifecycle owns focus and scroll lock until Svelte completes the global outro.
sheets.desktop: No handle or slide animation; existing centered-dialog presentation retained.

verification.before: 2 layout checks passed, 22 failed; each reported mobile tab strip scrolled vertically by 1px.
verification.after: 28 checks passed: 24 layout/tab cases plus motion-enabled and reduced-motion gesture/lifecycle cases.
verification.gestures: Chromium native touch dispatch: long drag, short drag, pointer cancellation; pointer-handle dismissal also passed in desktop Chromium and Firefox at a phone-sized viewport.
verification.keyboard: Close-button focus, Escape/opener restoration, reverse Tab through long forms, and page scroll lock through outro completion passed. A header-overlap issue discovered during implementation was corrected by using a separate content scroll region.
verification.broaderRegression: 158 rendered cases and 23 interaction checks passed after the changes.
